items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: Alphonso Trent's band went there and stayed. ... Snub Moseley was with Alphonso Trent.

ctx.x: Alphonso Trent's band went there and stayed. Jimmy Lunsford's band went there and made its headquarters there for a long time before it came to New York. Stuff Smith stayed there after Alphonso Trent got his band together.
